environment.description: Application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running directly on port 8080 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with the application's IAM database user granted full SELECT on all tables including pg_catalog. No query-level firewall or proxy between the application and the database. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, public schema + pg_catalog access
config.db_user_permissions: SELECT on all tables, no row-level security
